title: Cava Sales Jump as Americans Flock to Pita Chips, Salmon
summary: Cava is hot, kind of bucking a trend when it comes to eating out with prices generally rising. The fast-casual restaurant chain known for its Mediterranean-inspired dishes says sales rose faster than expected due to increased demand for its salmon and pita chips. Sales did slow down due the cyclospora outbreak. Michael Halen, Bloomberg Intelligence senior restaurant analyst, has more.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Cava Rises on Sales; CoreWeave Soars on AI Outlook | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Cava (CAVA) is also rising this morning as sales jumped with Americans flocking to Pita Chips, Salmon, and other Mediterranean-diet oriented foods.
- Super Micro (SMCI) is giving a sales outlook that topped even the rosiest projections. That along with Coreweave's report is sending markets higher.
- CoreWeave (CRWV) is soaring after booming AI demand bolstered the company's revenue outlook. Nebius (NBIS) is also up this morning with earnings coming out. (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)
